title: transport buttons
system_instruction_addendum: TRANSPORT BUTTONS ADDENDUM: Play, cue, and sync are deck transport. Cue plays from the cue point while held. Do not pre-empt the sync explanation; Course 2 owns sync.

tutor_speak.text: the transport row on each deck holds three buttons — play, cue, and sync.
press and hold the cue button on deck A — the track plays only while you hold it.

hints.text: the cue button sits next to play, usually labeled with a circle or CUE.
press cue on deck A — hold it down for a moment.
press the cue button on deck A now.
